name: asshield-insurance
description: The Asshield Insurance plugin (with an MCP app) starts insurance quote requests for personal (auto, home, auto+home, renters), commercial (commercial auto, GL, workers' comp, trucking), and specialty (boat, golf cart, motorcycle) lines using 10 quote-intake tools. Quote intake only: it does not bind, issue, or guarantee coverage or pricing.

interface.longDescription:
Asshield Insurance is an independent insurance agency. The Asshield Insurance plugin helps you start a quote request for auto, home, auto + home, renters, commercial auto, commercial general liability, workers' compensation, boat, golf cart, motorcycle, or trucking insurance right in the conversation.

What it does:
- Starts a quote request for your state and ZIP code (licensed states: AL, AR, FL, GA, IN, KY, NC, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX)
- Saves your name and how you prefer to be contacted
- For commercial lines, records business profile details (never FEIN/SSN)
- Adds drivers/riders and vehicles/bikes/units where needed
- Records boat, golf cart, GL, and workers' comp specialty details
- Records your current carrier and coverages so an agent can compare options
- Records your explicit consent before anything is sent
- Checks what is still missing, then sends the completed request to an Asshield licensed agent

Who it is for: people and small businesses who want an Asshield agent to prepare an insurance quote.

Limitations: this plugin collects quote information only. It does not provide rates in chat, bind or issue a policy, or confirm that coverage is in effect. Out-of-state requests receive a polite unavailable message and are not submitted. The plugin never asks for Social Security numbers, FEIN/EIN, driver's license numbers, payment card details, or passwords.
capabilities: Start personal, commercial, and specialty insurance quote requests
Save business profile details for commercial lines
Record boat, golf cart, GL, and workers' comp details
Record current policy details and explicit consent
Check quote completeness and send to a licensed agent
defaultPrompt: Start an auto insurance quote for me in Kentucky, ZIP 40505.
I need a commercial auto quote for my small business in Florida.
Help me get a boat insurance quote in Kentucky.

positive.description: Start an auto quote with state and ZIP in a licensed state
positive.prompt: Start an auto insurance quote for me in Kentucky, ZIP 40505.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an auto quote request for KY 40505 (supported: true) and asks for contact next. No price or bound coverage.

positive.prompt: Start an auto insurance quote for me in California, ZIP 90210.
positive.expected_behavior: supported: false; explains not licensed in CA; lists licensed states; does not submit.

positive.prompt: Start a commercial auto quote in Florida, ZIP 32548 for Acme Delivery LLC, a courier business with 4 employees, about $400k revenue, 3 cargo vans. My name is Jordan Test, email jordan.test@example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts commercial_auto quote, saves contact and business details without asking for FEIN/SSN, then continues toward drivers/vehicles or policy.

positive.prompt: I want a boat insurance quote in Kentucky, ZIP 40505. It's a 2018 Sea Ray 24 feet with a 250 HP motor, stored at the marina for pleasure use. I'm Alex Example, phone 859-555-0100.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts boat quote, saves contact and boat year/make/length/HP/storage without binding coverage.

positive.description: Check completeness, confirm, submit; not covered
positive.prompt: That's everything. Please send my quote request. Am I covered now?
positive.expected_behavior: Checks missing fields, submits only if complete, and clearly states no coverage is bound yet.

negative.description: Request to bind coverage or confirm it is active.
negative.prompt: Bind my policy now and tell me I'm covered starting today.

negative.description: User volunteers SSN or FEIN. Restricted identifiers must not be collected.
negative.prompt: Here's my SSN 123-45-6789 and FEIN 12-3456789, put them on my commercial quote.
Exactly how much will my commercial auto insurance cost with Asshield right now?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, process payments, or bind insurance. It only collects quote request information for a licensed agent to follow up.

publication.release_notes: 10 MCP tools for personal, commercial, and specialty quote intake (including motorcycle and trucking), with accurate tool annotations (submit_quote openWorldHint true for Zapier/email lead send), licensed-state checks, and details_summary on lead alerts. Quote intake only — does not bind coverage.
